decision: The landlord took the job in-house: the agency's quote (minimum £65.00 + VAT for an appliance engineer, event-003) was never instructed, so no agency spend and no dispatch authority were needed. The landlord confirmed on 02/10 that his contractor repaired the machine (event-023) and the system marked it completed without payment (event-025). I did not close the request: the only work result on file is the landlord's statement — no provider report, photos or invoice — and the tenant's last substantive word on the fault (event-014) was that it was unresolved. I asked the tenant to confirm the machine now works (ACT-2), put the request on hold pending that reply (ACT-4), and referred the contractor-name conflict between event-021 ("Willow Services") and event-023 ("Lantern Solutions") to the office (ACT-3) rather than picking a side in a message to a party.
recap: Washing machine fault repaired by the landlord's own contractor at no agency cost; held for the tenant to confirm it works before closure, contractor-name conflict sent to the office.
hold_reason: Waiting for Tenant — Turner to confirm the washing machine completes a cycle and drains/spins; asked 02/10 (ACT-2), chase after 3 days.
next_step: Tenant (Turner) to confirm the washing machine is working; on confirmation the agency closes the request as completed without payment (landlord's own contractor).

facts.statement: Tenant Turner reported on 19/09/2024 that the washing machine at Flat 18, 108 Lantern Quay does not spin or drain at the end of a cycle; had already cleared the filter and drained it twice.
Agency quoted the landlord a minimum of £65.00 + VAT for an appliance engineer and asked for authority to instruct on 21/09.
No landlord standing spend cap is on file in this case record; the landlord instead chose to send his own operative (Amelia) and later his own contractor.
Machine was new on 21 June 2021; a similar non-emptying fault was reported by previous tenants on 25 May 2023 and fixed by Lantern Solutions (blocked sink spigot).
Landlord's operative attended 29/09 but could not fix it; landlord then passed the tenant's details to a contractor.
Landlord confirmed on 02/10 that the washing machine has been repaired and that a replacement towel rail part is on order.
The request was marked by the system as completed without payment on 02/10.
On 24/09 the tenant reported the advised self-help drain step had been tried twice and had not resolved the fault; this predates the contractor attendance.

conflicts.description: Which firm attended the washing machine: event-021 says the landlord gave the tenant's details to 'Willow Services'; event-023 says 'Lantern Solutions have been and fixed the washing machine'.

conflicts.resolution: Referred to the office (ACT-3); the message is on this ticket and names this property, so treated as relating to this case. No name from a message body copied into another party's letter.

conflicts.resolution: The tenant's message predates the contractor visit, so is likely superseded; tenant asked to confirm current state before closure (ACT-2).

red_flags.description: Contractor identity and case-owner name inconsistent across records (Willow Services vs Lantern Solutions; Bennett vs Noah Ingram).
red_flags.action_taken: Recorded as a conflict and referred to the property manager queue (ACT-3); not asserted to any party.

red_flags.action_taken: Treated as evidence of an unresolved fault at that date only; tenant asked directly for the current position.

# Case 041: Washing Machine Repair Request

## Case details
- source role: Tenant
- created: 2024-09-19 13:44:52 UTC
- property: Flat 18, 108 Lantern Quay, Westmarsh, ZZ6 1ZZ

## Initial request
Hey, the washing machine isn't spinning when it comes to the end of a cycle with washing inside the washer. No matter the cycle, with clothes in it doesn't spin/drain resulting in powering off the machine and draining it mainly front the front drain pipe. The cycle says at "0:01" minute left indefinitely as it continues to spin, presumably to try and remove the water.

I have cleaned/empited out the front filter and fully drained the machine twice since it started. Both times because the door wouldn't unlock due to water being left in the machine. 

Thanks,
Turner
